newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai banks' deposits 588 bln yuan by end-June.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai banks' deposits 588 bln yuan by end-June.

text.p: Outstanding deposits in Shanghai banks reached 588 billion yuan by the end of June, compared with only 71.4 billion yuan at the beginning of 1992, the Business News said on Saturday.
Deposits have increased by over 100 billion yuan annually in the past five years, the newspaper said.
Outstanding loans by Shanghai banks by the end-June were 415.8 billion yuan against 94.9 billion yuan at the start of 1992, it said.

The newspaper said the rises were due to Shanghai's rapid development in the recent years, which had caused both domestic and foreign banks to pour into the city with all major Chinese banks now having branches in Shanghai.
Fifty foreign banks now have branches in Shanghai with nine of them approved to conduct local currency business, it said.
Seven of the nine foreign banks had already started yuan business, the newspaper said.
